entities.name: Kariamanickam Srinivasa Krishnan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sir Kariamanikkam Srinivasa Krishnan was an Indian physicist. He was a co-discoverer of Raman scattering, for which his mentor C. V. Raman was awarded the 1930 Nobel Prize in Physics.
